note: Ps62 the great trust psalm (corrected). Human IB core: the soul WAITING in silence (dumiyyah) for God alone; the HOPE (tiqvah) from him; the exhortation TRUST (batach) + POUR OUT the heart before him; the enemies' scheming - PLAN to thrust down, PLEASURE in falsehood, hypocrisy (BLESS outwardly but CURSE inwardly); the warnings - put no TRUST in extortion, set not your HEART on riches; the HEARD word that power+chesed belong to God. God-qualifiers=13 (salvation x3/fortress x2/refuge x2/mighty as the rock; spoken/power/chesed/render). Vanity-of-man assessment (breath/delusion/balances) + assault imagery (attack/batter/leaning-wall/tottering-fence) + extortion/robbery/riches objects = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: wait in silence / be still (dumiyyah - my soul waits in silence)
the same posture self-commanded in v5, grounded in hope
because from God comes his salvation (v1)

'For God alone my soul WAITS IN SILENCE (dumiyyah); from him comes my salvation' — the psalm's keynote: quiet, exclusive trust; dumiyyah here the stillness of a soul that has stopped its own striving and rests wholly on God — not passive but the deepest active reliance, silence as faith
plan / take counsel (yaats - they only plan to thrust him down)
to thrust him down from his high position
paired with their pleasure in falsehood

'They only PLAN (yaats) to thrust him down from his high position' — the single-minded scheming of the foes; yaats here their whole counsel bent on toppling him — plotting joined to a delight in lies (v4)
take pleasure / delight (ratsah - they take pleasure in falsehood)
paired with the falsehood they love

'They TAKE PLEASURE (ratsah) in falsehood' — the heart's delight in lies; ratsah here the enemies' approving relish for deceit — not merely using falsehood but loving it, the inner corruption behind the hypocrisy that follows
the object of their pleasure; expressed in the false blessing
'they take pleasure in FALSEHOOD (kazab)' — the lie that is the enemies' delight; kazab (deception) the falsehood they love — which shows in blessing with the mouth while cursing within
bless (barak - they bless with their mouths)
with their mouths, while cursing within

'They BLESS (barak) with their mouths, but inwardly they curse' — the split of the hypocrite; barak here the outward blessing that masks an inward curse — the mouth and the heart at war, the very portrait of the false (cf the betrayer, Ps55:21)
the true reality beneath the outward blessing

'but inwardly they CURSE (qalal)' — the real interior beneath the smooth mouth; qalal here the hidden curse in the heart while the lips bless — the definitive exposure of the false, honouring with words and hating within
hope / expectation (tiqvah - my hope is from him)
the ground of the self-commanded silent waiting

'For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my HOPE (tiqvah) is from him' — the psalmist commanding his own soul, grounding the stillness in hope; tiqvah here the expectation that comes from God alone — the reason the soul can be silent, that its whole future is in his hand
trust (batach - trust in him at all times)
paired with pouring out the heart before God
because God is a refuge for us (v8)

'TRUST (batach) in him at all times, O people' — the psalmist turning his own trust into an appeal to all; batach here trust urged 'at all times' — in prosperity and distress alike — because God is a refuge (v8, the qualifier), over against the vain trust in riches (v10)
heart (leb - pour out your heart before him)
paired with trusting God at all times

'pour out your HEART (leb) before him' — total inner openness to God; leb here the whole inner self emptied out in prayer, holding nothing back — the intimacy that answers trust, laying the heart bare before the God who is refuge
trust (batach - put no trust in extortion)
the misplaced counterpart to trusting God (v8), and to the heart set on riches

'Put no TRUST (batach) in extortion; set no vain hopes on robbery' — trust misdirected to ill-gotten gain; batach here the same verb as trusting God (v8), warned against when aimed at wealth won by force — the reliance that must rest on God, not plunder
heart (leb - set not your heart on them)
set (the heart on riches, warned against)
the same misdirection as trusting extortion

'if riches increase, set not your HEART (leb) on them' — the warning against the heart's attachment to wealth; leb here the affections that must not fasten on riches even as they grow — the same heart to be poured out before God (v8) must not be set on gold
hear / receive (shama - twice have I heard this)
that power and steadfast love belong to God

'Once God has spoken; twice have I HEARD (shama) this: that power belongs to God, and that to you belongs steadfast love' — the attentive reception of God's twofold word; shama here the taking-in of the two great truths that ground all trust - power AND steadfast love both belong to God (the qualifiers), so the soul may safely be silent before him
salvation (yeshuah - from him comes my salvation)
God's salvation, why the soul waits for him alone (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'from him comes my SALVATION (yeshuah)' - God's saving is not a human IB char; the reason the soul waits in silence for God alone (280918). Qualifier.
salvation (yeshuah - he only is my rock and my salvation)
God as the psalmist's rock and salvation, ground of his waiting (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God as salvation): 'He only is my rock and my SALVATION (yeshuah)' - God as saving-rock is not a human IB char; the exclusive ground ('he only') of the waiting soul (280918), so he is not greatly shaken. Qualifier.
God as the psalmist's fortress, ground of his waiting (v2)
v2 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'my FORTRESS (misgab)' - God as stronghold is not a human IB char; the high refuge on which the waiting soul (280918) rests unshaken. Qualifier.
salvation (yeshuah - my rock and my salvation)
God as rock and salvation, ground of the psalmist's hope (v6)

v6 QUALIFIER (God as salvation): 'He only is my rock and my SALVATION (yeshuah)' - God as saving-rock is not a human IB char; the refrain-ground of the psalmist's hope (280969), so he shall not be shaken. Qualifier.
God as fortress, ground of the psalmist's hope (v6)
v6 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'my FORTRESS (misgab)' - God as stronghold is not a human IB char; the refrain-refuge grounding the psalmist's hope (280969). Qualifier.
salvation (yesha - on God rests my salvation)
the psalmist's salvation rests on God, ground of his hope (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God-grounded salvation): 'On God rests my SALVATION (yesha) and my glory' - the salvation that rests on God is not a human IB char; the deliverance grounding the psalmist's hope (280969). Qualifier.
God as the psalmist's mighty rock and refuge (v7)
v7 QUALIFIER (God as strength): 'my MIGHTY (oz) rock, my refuge is God' - God's strength is not a human IB char; the strong rock in which the psalmist's hope (280969) takes refuge. Qualifier.
God as the psalmist's refuge, ground of his hope (v7)
v7 QUALIFIER (God as refuge): 'my REFUGE (machseh) is God' - God as refuge is not a human IB char; the shelter grounding the psalmist's hope (280969). Qualifier.
refuge (machseh - God is a refuge for us)
God is a refuge for us, ground of the call to trust (v8)
v8 QUALIFIER (God as refuge): 'God is a REFUGE (machseh) for us' - God as refuge is not a human IB char; the reason all are urged to trust him and pour out their hearts (280986). Qualifier.
God's speaking, the word the psalmist heard (v11)
v11 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'Once God has SPOKEN (dabar)' - God's speaking is not a human IB char; the divine utterance the psalmist has attentively heard (280933). Qualifier.
power / strength (oz - power belongs to God)
power belongs to God, the first truth the psalmist heard (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's power): 'that POWER (oz) belongs to God' - God's power is not a human IB char; the first of the two great truths the psalmist heard (280933) - that all strength is God's. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - to you belongs steadfast love)
steadfast love belongs to God, the second truth the psalmist heard (v12)

v12 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'and that to you, O Lord, belongs STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the second great truth the psalmist heard (280933) - power and love together are God's, the twin ground of trust. Qualifier.
render / repay (shalam - you will render to a man according to his work)
God renders to each according to his work, part of the word heard (v12)

v12 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'For you will RENDER (shalam) to a man according to his work' - God's just recompense is not a human IB char; the corollary of his power and love that the psalmist heard (280933) - the assurance of moral order. Qualifier.
soul (nefesh - my soul waits in silence)
v1: 'my SOUL (nefesh) waits in silence' - the bearer of the silent waiting; the waiting itself is the char (280918, bearer=soul). Standalone (the waiting-bearer).
be shaken / moved (mot - I shall not be greatly shaken)

v2: 'I shall not be greatly SHAKEN (mot)' - the stability of the trusting soul; the being-shaken (negated) is the security that flows from God being his rock, carried in the waiting char (280918). Standalone (negated shaking).
assault / set upon (hathath - how long will you attack a man?)
v3: 'How long will all of you ATTACK (hathath) a man?' - the enemies' assault; the bare aggression, their scheming the char (v4). Standalone (enemy assault).
v3: 'to BATTER (ratsach) him' - the enemies' violent assault on the man; part of the attack-imagery. Standalone (assault).
lean / be bent (natah - like a leaning wall)
v3: 'like a LEANING (natah) wall' - the image of the man's precariousness under attack; a tottering structure about to fall. Standalone (image).
v3: 'a leaning WALL (qir)' - the image of the beleaguered man as a wall about to collapse. Standalone (image).
totter / be thrust (dachah - a tottering fence)
v3: 'a TOTTERING (dachah) fence' - the image of the man's instability under the enemies' battering. Standalone (image).
v3: 'a tottering FENCE (gader)' - the image of the beleaguered man as a fence about to fall. Standalone (image).
thrust down (nadach - to thrust him down)
v4: 'they only plan to thrust him DOWN (nadach)' - the aim of the enemies' plotting; the scheming is the char (280953), here the intended overthrow. Standalone (the aim).
high position / dignity (seeth - from his high position)
v4: 'to thrust him down from his HIGH POSITION (seeth)' - the standing the enemies would topple; the object of their scheme. Standalone (the position targeted).
mouth (peh - they bless with their mouths)
v4: 'They bless with their MOUTHS (peh)' - the mouth as the organ of the hypocritical blessing; the blessing itself is the char (280959). Standalone (the mouth).
v5: 'For God alone, O my SOUL (nefesh), wait in silence' - the soul self-addressed; the hope that grounds the waiting is the char (280969, seat=soul). Standalone (the addressee-self).
be shaken / moved (mot - I shall not be shaken)
v6: 'I shall not be SHAKEN (mot)' - the stability of the hoping soul (refrain, cf v2); the security carried in the hope char (280969). Standalone (negated shaking).

v7: 'On God rests my salvation and my GLORY (kavod)' - the psalmist's honour/dignity, which (like his salvation) rests wholly on God; an attribute grounded in God, not an inner operation. Standalone (God-grounded honour).
pour out (shaphak - pour out your heart)
v8: 'POUR OUT (shaphak) your heart before him' - the verb of the heart's unreserved openness; the act of pouring out the heart is the char (280991). Standalone (the pouring).
breath / vapour (hebel - those of low estate are but a breath)

v9: 'Those of low estate are but a BREATH (hebel)' - the assessment of human worthlessness; men weighed and found empty, the foil to God who has all power (v11). Standalone (vanity-of-man assessment).
lie / delusion (kazab - those of high estate are a delusion)
v9: 'those of high estate are a DELUSION (kazab)' - even the mighty are unreliable, a lie to trust in; the assessment that all men, high and low, are vanity. Standalone (vanity-of-man assessment).
balances / scales (mozen - in the balances they go up)
v9: 'in the BALANCES (mozen) they go up' - the image of weighing men and finding them weightless; part of the vanity-assessment. Standalone (image).
go up / rise (alah - they go up)
v9: 'in the balances they GO UP (alah)' - men so light they rise in the scale; the image of their weightlessness/vanity. Standalone (image).
breath / vapour (hebel - lighter than a breath)
v9: 'they are together lighter than a BREATH (hebel)' - the summation of human vanity; men weightless as vapour, over against the God who holds all power. Standalone (vanity-of-man assessment).
extortion / oppression (osheq - put no trust in extortion)
v10: 'Put no trust in EXTORTION (osheq)' - the ill-gotten gain not to be trusted; the object of the warned-against trust (the char, 280921). Standalone (the false object of trust).
become vain / set vain hopes (habal - set no vain hopes on robbery)
v10: 'set no VAIN HOPES (habal) on robbery' - the empty hoping in stolen gain; the misdirected reliance carried in the trust char (280921). Standalone (the vain hoping).
v10: 'set no vain hopes on ROBBERY (gazel)' - the plunder not to be relied on; the false object of hope. Standalone (the false object).
v10: 'if RICHES (chayil) increase' - the growing wealth on which the heart must not be set; the object of the warned-against attachment (the char, 280928). Standalone (the wealth).
increase / bear fruit (nub - if riches increase)
v10: 'if riches INCREASE (nub)' - the growth of wealth; the condition under which the heart must not fasten on riches (280928). Standalone (the increase).
set / place (shith - set not your heart on them)
v10: 'SET (shith) not your heart on them' - the verb of the heart's attachment warned against; the setting of the heart on riches is the char (280928). Standalone (the setting).
work / deed (maaseh - according to his work)
v12: 'you will render to a man according to his WORK (maaseh)' - the deeds by which God recompenses each; the basis of the just rendering (qualifier 280941). Standalone (the deeds judged).
